title: Vibrant Smoky Brazilian Haricot Bean Stew
description: A tangy and comforting Brazilian stew featuring haricot beans and a smoky flavor, perfect for a sick day. This egg-free dish is easy to make and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Rinse the dried haricot beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours.
Drain and rinse the beans, then set them aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, and soaked haricot beans.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 45 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
